findings.text: _refused_delivered_review is the third caller of recovery._review_in_flight and is still handed the unfiltered live-pointer snapshot, so in the two-request case this delta exists for (a launched review and a queued one standing for the same head, the queued sorting first) the queued pointer can win the sweep and the refused-delivery reading is skipped. It is latent because a live launched review suppresses the duty upstream, but the commit's own subject says each reader recognises a review by its phase and this one does not.

When two queued reviews stand for one head, recovery._review_in_flight returns whichever entry of the narrowed `queued` list list_live lists first, and the earliest-queued_at tie-break the replaced sweep had is still absent, so the reported position can name the later request. Carried from the previous review, whose phase half this delta fixes.
